analysis.calibration: 128 independent primary worlds per domain/model/representation/k, max nonconformity per world
analysis.decision_score: same max restricted to physically feasible G; empty maximum is zero
analysis.envelope: L={g:p(g)>q}; U={g:p(g)>=1-q}; decision rules only inspect queried physical states
analysis.invalid: invalid draws contribute an empty proposal to scores; if every draw invalid, model policies ABSTAIN
analysis.multiplicity: Holm across 32 prespecified tests: 2 models x 2 domains x 2 representations x 4 endpoints
analysis.paired_primary: decision calibrated versus semantic calibrated, alpha=.05,k=3, full query budget; domains/models/representations kept separate
analysis.quantile: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) order statistic, infinity if rank > n; conservatively clamp q >= 0.5
analysis.scope: marginal per-world error bound under exchangeability, not error conditional on execution; synthetic language only
analysis.semantic_score: max(1-p(g) for g in S, p(g) for g in G minus S)

data.primary_distribution: independent RNG seeds; nuisance density, instruction style, and 0/1/2 intended feasible base types sampled per cluster
data.variants: one iid primary per cluster; test first 64 and calibration first 32 have paired +F/+I diagnostic scenes

protocol.gate: engineering correctness and syntactic smoke only; no semantic accuracy qualification

inference.constraint: lm-format-enforcer 0.11.3 JSON schema; no semantic filtering
inference.failure_policy: retain invalid/truncated/error; do not automatically retry dispatched requests
inference.thinking: Qwen3 native thinking prefix, up to 2048 reasoning tokens then constrained JSON answer; forced closing at cap recorded
inference.times: shared resource wall time and token counts, not exclusive speed comparisons

registration: local timestamp and SHA-256 only; not public preregistration
